title: OL-20261113-1: Tick Worker credential binding
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** each deploy-workers run
**Done check:** file:ops/bindings.jsonl
**Status:** open

Root gap: deployed ultrastable-tick has no GITHUB_TOKEN or GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN, so lane and executor providers report no-token. deploy/bind-worker-secrets.mjs copies LANE_PAT into Worker secrets each deploy and logs ops/bindings.jsonl. Minting LANE_PAT is the one identity-bound step (default in effect: Actions-hosted lane keeps merging). Session: session_0156nqDv8ijT11RmKre7xEmK
